name: bare-format

exports.name: format
exports.description: Formats `args` into a string, printf-style. If the first argument is a string containing `%s`, `%d`, `%i`, `%f`, `%j`, `%o`, `%O`, or `%c` placeholders, each is substituted with the corresponding argument; any remaining arguments are appended, space-separated, using `bare-inspect` for non-string values.

params.name: args
params.description: An optional printf-style format string followed by the values to format.
